verdict.rationale: The only OpenAI-compatible endpoint in the evidence is the hosted Wally Cloud API (docs-4, under wally-cloud), which runs on RunAnywhere's hardware rather than locally. The local CLI evidence (docs-6, docs-7) shows running a model offline and pointing tools at it, but never documents a local OpenAI-compatible server for loaded models. The serving axis applies to this kind of product, so the lack of evidence makes this none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model
